paper_claims.claim: HyMeS improves mean CSR from 52.5% to 66.2% and TSR from 41.3% to 60.1% over pi0.5 on RoboMemArena.
HyMeS outperforms PrediMem by 4.5 points in CSR (66.2% vs 61.7%) and 14.5 points in TSR (60.1% vs 45.6%).
On real SO-101 robot, HyMeS achieves 7/10 on observe-and-pick-up, 11/15 on number-guided button pressing, and 2/10 on put-back block.
Rollout-driven heuristic learning improves TSR from 53.3% to 71.7% over one-shot P(0).
PACE combines proprioception and Qwen3-VL-8B multi-frame judgments with a k-of-w voting window (w=5, k=3).
paper_claims.source: Section: Multimodal Progress Verification and Memory Update
